champions.name: EMBERLING
champions.lore: The youngest of Vexalith's brood. Nobody has ever talked back to it.

champions.name: CINDERA
champions.lore: The walls here are scratched with tally marks: everyone who came down before you.

champions.name: ASHKA
champions.lore: It has counted every one of those marks, and it can tell you whose they were.

champions.name: SCORIA
champions.lore: You can hear the Last Door now, breathing somewhere under the floor.

champions.name: VEXALITH
champions.lore: It has waited at the Last Door a long time for someone who wasn't alone.

premise.title: THE LAST DOOR
premise.banner: Five floors down, and the only way out.
premise.door: It only opens for someone who is not alone.
premise.line: Thrown down here. The only way out is the Last Door, five floors below.
